# The DRIPBaR Edina

> The DRIPBaR Edina is an IV therapy and wellness lounge in Edina, Minnesota. Services include IV vitamin drips, intramuscular quick shots, NAD+ infusions, High Dose Vitamin C, physician-guided GLP-1 medical weight management, medically supervised peptide therapy, and wellness therapies, delivered by a licensed clinical team under physician oversight. Every first visit begins with a brief health screening.

Key facts:
- Address: 3515 W. 70th St, Edina, MN 55435
- Phone (call or text): (612) 324-4740
- Hours: Monday to Friday: 10 AM to 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM to 4 PM; Sunday: 11 AM to 3 PM
- Booking: https://thedripbaredina.com/booking (online, 24/7) or by phone
- Pricing: Lifestyle IV drips are $224 regular and $179 for members. Some drips (100% Hydration, NAD+, High Dose Vitamin C, add-on drips) are priced separately.
- New guest offer: $20 off your first appointment for new guests.
- All IV drips and quick shots are administered by registered nurses under physician oversight. Nothing on this site is medical advice; a consultation is required for GLP-1, peptide, High Dose Vitamin C, Ozone Therapy, and NAD+ planning.
